title: AddressDtoMapper null handling changed
query: What breaks if AddressDtoMapper changes its null handling for optional address fields?

proposed_change.diff:
-                address.line2(), address.city(), address.state(), address.postalCode(),
+                nullToEmpty(address.line2()), address.city(), address.state(), address.postalCode(),

affected_repositories.name: account-service
affected_repositories.evidence_note: AddressDtoMapper is called by AddressController for responses; empty-string line2 shifts the API shape without changing its schema

notes: Mapper-level variant of the REST-001 family with no cross-repo effect: the schema is unchanged, only a value normalization. Distinguishes tools that report every touched file from tools that report actual blast radius.
